library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

rounding pi
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
repeating numbers
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
```
repeating numbers again
```{r}
print(rep(x=5, times= 7))
```
types of variables
```{r}
#define variables
numeric_variable <- 5
character_variable <- "hello world"
logic_variable <- TRUE
#print variables and define their classes
print(numeric_variable)
print(class(numeric_variable))
print(character_variable)
print(class(character_variable))
print(logic_variable)
print(class(logic_variable))
```
cells and radiation experiment variables 
```{r}
cell_ID1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID2 <- "CX2"
treated1 <- TRUE
treated2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before1 <- 5415
num_cells_before2 <- 8123
num_cells_after1 <- 1432
num_cells_after2 <- 7543
```

vectors
```{r}
cell_ID_vec <- c(cell_ID1, cell_ID2)
treated_vec <- c(treated1, treated2)
num_cells_before_vec <- c(num_cells_before1, num_cells_before2)
num_cells_after_vec <- c(num_cells_after1, num_cells_after2)
```

vector exercise 
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth_pet <- all_my_pets[4]
print(fourth_pet)
```

table of data
```{r}
my_table <- tibble(
  Cell_ID = cell_ID_vec,
  Treated = treated_vec,
  Num_cells_before = num_cells_before_vec,
  Num_cells_after = num_cells_after_vec
)

gt(my_table)
```
